paraphrase: Possibility-defined conception satisfies H by definition. Satisfiability somewhere does not imply root-accessible possibility on identity Bool accessibility. The grammatical language can describe a contradiction and can label collapse without licensing imaginative conception. The old bounded mere-ideas-withholding interface is compatible with both an empty conception satisfying H and indiscriminate conception violating H; this is an interface compatibility test, not a model of Hume’s complete epistemology.
